body:
~One interesting point is that this issue only occurs with instantiated scenes.~

~The MRP has two scene, main.tscn and animation_scene.tscn. It instantiates and adds animation_scene.tscn to main.tscn. Running animation_scene.tscn alone does not reproduce this issue, but it does occur in main.tscn.~

~This might be less a problem with time progression and more related to instantiation or pointer confusion.~

It seems the cause is main.tscn sets the FPS, so not related instantiate.
